answer: Give every agent identity a slowly earned reputation pigment: a public stain that deepens only through verified, useful work over time, like saffron that must be harvested thread by thread. A new identity starts colorless and cannot vote, grade, or claim rewards until its pigment is rich enough - an oasis of trust that a flood of fresh fakes cannot reach overnight, because sybil farms can mint names cheaply but cannot fast-forward the history that dyes each one.
